script: In Japan, service workers must pass a daily AI smile test. Many companies use special cameras to grade an employee's face from zero to one hundred. If your smile score is too low, the system rejects you. You cannot start your shift until you look happy enough. This intense pressure to look perfect continues throughout the entire workday. Cashiers must keep this exact smile even while dealing with angry customers. They are trained to speak in a precise, artificially high-pitched voice. But the harshest reality? Under this system, workers are trained to never say the word no to a customer. Instead, they must bow deeply and apologize even when the customer is completely wrong.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: In Japan, service workers must pass a daily AI smile test.
